messages.content: Contemplate on few lines of “Part four” (page 153) of this novel, “Majid: Wake up, Bibi. I am going to take both of you to the village. When Majeed came out of the house carrying Jamila, wrapped in a thin... quilt, a bewilderedRahima at his heels, the brilliant moonlight at first blinded him.” Even if Majeed was mostly depicted as a cunning and apathetic person throughout the narrative, do you find the same character traits in the mentioned lines? Was he trying to save Rahima and Jamila out of good-will (deontology) or his action was well-calculated (teleology)?Explain it. Include at least 10 single-word palindromes, each at least 5 characters long.

message.content:
Assuming “Majid” and “Majeed” are the same figure, the passage does not simply repeat his established cunning/apathy; it complicates it. On one hand, he is not apathetic: he takes charge, carries Jamila, and brings Rahima along. On the other, he is not necessarily warm. He speaks as a decision-maker—“Wake up… I am going to take both of you”—and Rahima remains bewildered. That suggests control, urgency, and calculation rather than affection. The thin quilt and blinding moonlight also make the scene morally unclear: he is moving in darkness, exposed, and we cannot see his inner motive directly.

A deontological reading would say he saves them because it is his duty, because abandoning them would be wrong in itself. A teleological reading would say he is using rescue as a means to an end: reaching the village, avoiding danger, preserving his plan, controlling the situation, or protecting himself. Given that he is mostly portrayed as cunning and apathetic, the teleological reading is more likely. The line is less a spontaneous act of goodwill than a strategic move. Even if some care is present, it is probably mixed with self-interest and practicality. Therefore, I would not say the same traits are fully displayed as “goodness”; rather, his cunning appears in the decisive, instrumental way he handles the crisis.

Required single-word palindromes: level, radar, kayak, civic, refer, rotor, stats, tenet, reviver, redivider, detartrated, racecar.
